locus: §4.3 — “The ordering is exactly what the mechanism predicts”
current:
The ordering is exactly what the mechanism predicts — the more preparable the
format, the more machine drafting — and it is the one place where the lexicon
arm's inference is confirmed by an independent instrument. Two instruments
agreeing is worth more than either alone.
proposed:
The ordering matches the proposed mechanism: machine drafting rises with the
advance preparation that a format permits. It also independently confirms the
same genre pattern found by the lexicon instrument, so the result does not
depend on either instrument alone.
rationale: This keeps the triangulation claim while replacing the conversational and imprecise “worth more” formulation with the specific inferential benefit of agreement between instruments.
